about_the_game:
Welcome to Brix Infinite, where the timeless brick-breaker game enters the modern age! Harness the power of attention, sharpen your mind, and reset with every brick you break.

■ Endless Challenges, Limitless Fun

With over 24,000 levels spread across over 750 dynamic themes, Brix Infinite offers a vast and engaging gameplay experience. Progress through the game by clearing all the bricks on each level to unlock new themes and exciting challenges. Stay motivated with an active leaderboard, where you can compete with others or push yourself to beat your personal best.

■ Elevate Your Focus, One Brick at a Time

Brix Infinite isn’t just a game, it’s your personal focus companion, designed to help you lead the day with improved attention, dexterity, and cognitive skills. This isn’t just about breaking bricks, it’s about building better habits for concentration and relaxation.

■ Seamless Play & Pause, On Your Terms

Life doesn’t pause, and neither should your game. Need to take a call or reply to a message? No problem, pause anytime and resume right where you left off, seamlessly moving between desktop and mobile phone. Whether you’re playing for a quick mental reset or an extended challenge, Brix Infinite adapts to your pace.

■ Make It Your Own

Personalize your experience with a beautiful background, a family-friendly avatar and a custom nickname that reflects your style. Take control of your focus, sharpen your mind, and enjoy a safe, immersive gaming experience.

Download Brix Infinite today and start breaking bricks—one mindful move at a time.

READY, SET, BREAK!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200 / Intel® Core™ i3-3330
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200 / Intel® Core™ i5-6500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
